title: An invitation link can be used more than once
problem: The controller finds the invitation by token and never marks it accepted, so a forwarded link adds another member.
impact: Anyone who receives a forwarded link joins the workspace.
fix: accept only an invitation that is not accepted yet, and mark it accepted in the same step.

title: An expired invitation still lets the colleague in
problem: `expires_at` is written but never read, so a link older than 7 days still adds a member (issue #593, *The rules*).
fix: accept only an invitation whose expiry is still in the future.

title: The daily invitation limit has its own counter
problem: `app/Support/RateLimit/DailyQuota.php:12` already counts a per-user daily quota, and the API entry point skips the new counter.
impact: The two entry points count differently.
fix: use the existing daily quota in both entry points, with a limit of 20 invitations per owner a day.
